object.name: evi.skfinputmix~
object.description: A special kind of input mixing filter, where the multimode nature of the filter is provided by it's simultaneous inputs rather than on outputs. By default the inputs are mixed by the @mix attribute and therefore has the effect of output mixing a standard multimode Sallen Key. However if disabling the @mixenable attribute the inputs are 'always on', and can therefore be sequenced externally in interesting ways. This Sallen Key input mixer has excellent performance across a full range of cutoff frequencies. The filter is nonlinear and can take any sort of input.

inlets.description: Audio to this inlet produces the Lowpass output.
Audio to this inlet produces the Bandpass output.
Audio to this inlet produces the Highpass output.

messages.name: history
messages.digest: Top level gen~ [history] / History() declarations can be reset by messages to the object

attributes.name: coeffsmooth
attributes.description: Optionally smooth the internal coefficients calculations. This takes care of smoothing the changes incurred by @cutoff and @res attributes. This should typically be on.

attributes.name: cutoff
attributes.description: The filter cutoff frequency in Hz. This filter performs predictably with a wide range of cutoff frequencies.

attributes.name: mix
attributes.description: Only available if @mixenable is on (the default). Interpolates between Lowpass..Bandpass..Highpass inlets. Interpolation is a gain matched cosine algorithm.

attributes.name: mixenable
attributes.description: If enabled (the default) the @mix attribute can interpolate between Lowpass..Bandpass..Highpass. Turn off for controlling the audio inputs via sequenced gates (for example).

attributes.name: mixsmooth
attributes.description: Optionally smooth the @mix attribute if @mixenable is active. This should typically be on.

attributes.name: res
attributes.description: The filter resonance. Resonance in this filter performs predictably across the full range of @cutoff frequencies.
